summary: Approved 5 completed ownership records after independent web verification. Rejected pending/announced deals and update-only items where no new completed transfer of control could be verified as of 2026-08-15.

approved_deals.direct_owner: ABOUT YOU Holding AG / ABYxZAL Holding AG
approved_deals.one_line_summary: German fashion e-commerce platform ABOUT YOU was taken over by Zalando, with control completed on 2025-07-11 and the squeeze-out/delisting finalized on 2025-11-06.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Zalando acquired 91.45% of ABOUT YOU share capital at closing on 2025-07-11. The merger squeeze-out became effective on 2025-11-06, transferring remaining minority shares to Zalando subsidiary ABYxZAL Holding AG, which assumed ABOUT YOU Holding SE’s legal position and operates as ABOUT YOU Holding AG.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Official ABOUT YOU/Zalando releases directly confirm completed control acquisition and final squeeze-out/delisting; current owner is Zalando SE.

sources.title: Zalando and ABOUT YOU Successfully Complete Transaction and Team Up to Lead the Way in European Fashion and Lifestyle E-commerce
sources.summary: Confirms Zalando and ABOUT YOU completed their strategic combination on 2025-07-11 and Zalando acquired 91.45% of ABOUT YOU share capital.

sources.title: ABOUT YOU and Zalando Complete Final Step of their Strategic Combination
sources.summary: Confirms the merger squeeze-out became effective on 2025-11-06, remaining minority shares transferred to ABYxZAL Holding AG, and ABOUT YOU shares were delisted.

approved_deals.direct_owner: MIH Bidco Holdings B.V. / Prosus N.V.
approved_deals.one_line_summary: Netherlands-origin food-delivery platform Just Eat Takeaway.com came under Prosus control after its tender offer settled on 2025-10-06.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: MIH Bidco Holdings B.V., an indirectly wholly-owned subsidiary of Prosus N.V., acquired 90.13% at initial settlement on 2025-10-06 and reached 98.19% after the post-closing acceptance period, with delisting scheduled for 2025-11-17. Naspers is identified by the official releases as majority owner of Prosus.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Official JET/Naspers releases confirm the offer became unconditional, settlement date, resulting Prosus/MIH Bidco ownership, and Naspers majority ownership of Prosus.

sources.title: Prosus declares Offer for Just Eat Takeaway.com unconditional
sources.summary: Confirms all offer conditions were satisfied, the deal could close, and settlement would occur on 2025-10-06 with Prosus holding approximately 90.13% after settlement.

sources.title: Final results of Prosus offer for Just Eat Takeaway.com
sources.summary: Confirms MIH Bidco is an indirectly wholly-owned Prosus subsidiary, Prosus would hold 98.19% after the post-closing period, delisting timing, and that Prosus is majority-owned by Naspers.

approved_deals.direct_owner: Castellano Investments S.à r.l. / Tendam Brands S.A.U.
approved_deals.one_line_summary: UAE-listed Multiply Group completed the acquisition of a 67.91% controlling stake in Spanish apparel group Tendam on 2025-07-23.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Multiply Group now has a 67.91% majority interest in Castellano Investments S.à r.l., owner of Tendam Brands S.A.U. and other subsidiaries. CVC Funds and PAI Partners vehicles remain minority shareholders. The source notes Bosnia and Herzegovina businesses were subject to a separate local authorization, but the main Tendam control transaction completed.
approved_deals.approval_reason: A company-issued Business Wire release explicitly confirms completion, the 67.91% majority interest, and the ownership chain through Castellano Investments to Tendam Brands.

sources.title: Multiply Group Completes Acquisition of Tendam, Doubling Operational EBITDA and Expanding Global Footprint
sources.summary: Confirms Multiply completed its first major European investment by acquiring a 67.91% majority interest in Castellano Investments S.à r.l., owner of Tendam Brands S.A.U., with CVC and PAI vehicles remaining minority shareholders.

approved_deals.one_line_summary: Italian fashion group OTB completed the acquisition of 100% of Dutch luxury brand Viktor&Rolf on 2026-06-04.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: This is an incremental full-ownership record rather than first control: OTB acquired 51% in 2008, increased to 70% in 2019, and completed acquisition of 100% in 2026.
approved_deals.approval_reason: OTB’s official release directly confirms completion of the 100% acquisition and the brand’s place in the OTB portfolio.

sources.title: OTB acquires 100% of Viktor&Rolf
sources.summary: Confirms OTB completed the acquisition of 100% of Viktor&Rolf on 2026-06-04 and notes OTB’s prior majority stakes in 2008 and 2019.

approved_deals.one_line_summary: US luxury resale company FASHIONPHILE acquired Luxe Collective’s IP, customer database and social channels on 2025-10-14 to launch FASHIONPHILE UK.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: This is an asset acquisition rather than a full operating company acquisition. The acquired assets include Luxe Collective intellectual property, customer database and social media channels; the existing Luxe Collective social channels are evolving into FASHIONPHILE Collective and founders joined FASHIONPHILE UK.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Official FASHIONPHILE-distributed release and FASHIONPHILE’s own site confirm the completed asset acquisition and launch of FASHIONPHILE UK.

sources.title: FASHIONPHILE Acquires Luxe Collective, Marking Entry into the UK Luxury Resale Market
sources.summary: Confirms FASHIONPHILE acquired Luxe Collective’s intellectual property, customer database and social media channels and launched FASHIONPHILE UK.

sources.title: FASHIONPHILE Acquires Luxe Collective
sources.summary: FASHIONPHILE’s own site describes the Luxe Collective acquisition as its first international expansion and the start of FASHIONPHILE UK.
